status: Experimental anatomy capability numbers for the isolated Adaptive Combat Lab. Provisional; not balance.

marrow_graft.status: Illustrative only (owner example, 2026-10-22): not an approved item, name or final stats.
marrow_graft.note: A marrow growth along the left forearm. The arm and hand keep their ordinary function (grip, two-handed holds). Benefit: passive health regeneration after a short delay. Drawbacks: weaker defence (more damage taken) and more stagger damage received (posture damage and stagger time).

handless_limb_example.status: Test fixture for anatomy-driven restrictions; not offered in the lab UI.
handless_limb_example.note: A replacement limb whose generated anatomy has no grasping hand. Grips that need that hand become illegal; this is the only kind of modification that changes what can be held.
